questions.question: Before fighting the Ammonites, Jephthah vowed that something would belong to the LORD if he won. What was it?

answers.text: Whatever came out his door to greet him
The first lamb born in his flock
A tenth of what he took in battle

questions.question: After Jephthah defeated the Ammonites and returned home to Mizpah, who came out to meet him with tambourines and dancing?
After winning the war against the Ammonites, why did Jephthah say he could not take back his vow?

answers.text: He gave his word to the LORD
The elders of Gilead heard it
He swore it before his army

questions.question: When Jephthah went to fight the Ammonites, the LORD delivered them into his hand. True or false?
